blocks.text: It's common to carry a "gift-mix" - a combination of two or more ministry gifts, with one usually more dominant than the others. It's worth discovering your dominant gift, so you don't end up majoring on your minor and minoring on your major. The more effectively you operate in your ministry gifts, the more relevant you become to the body of Christ and the world.

As the body of Christ has grown, other gifts and ministries have emerged that Scripture doesn't explicitly name - drama, music, instrumentation, speech, writing, and art among them. They might simply be called talents, but their role in evangelism and soul-winning, through inspirational and creative expression, shouldn't be underestimated.
